p.src: A Song of Ascents. By David.

en: A Song of Ascents. By David.
u.src: A Song of Ascents. By David.

p.src: 1  LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

en: LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
u.src: 1  LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

p.src: 2  Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

en: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
u.src: 2  Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

p.src: 3  Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.

en: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
u.src: 3  Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.
